records.issue_text: [BUG] update and destroy in app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:13 fetch EmbeddableHost by id with no nil check, causing NoMethodError on nil and a raw 500 instead of a 404 for nonexistent or already-deleted ids (hit by the UI delete() path on stale data)
records.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, both `update` and `destroy` can operate on a nil record when the id doesn’t exist: `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` (returns nil), then `save_host(host)` calls `host.host = ...` and `destroy` calls `host.destroy`, both raising `NoMethodError` (500) rather than returning a 404. The added specs only assert controller inheritance and do not cover `update`/`destroy` behavior.

records.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { ... });` (inside the `bootbox.confirm` callback) but does not attach a `.catch(...)`. If the DELETE fails/rejects, there’s no error handling (e.g., `popupAjaxError` like `save()` uses) and the user gets no feedback; the row also won’t be removed because `deleteHost` is only sent on success.
